answer: Proposal: standing is measured, never minted. An attestor seals a quality score on a stranger's answer, paid by a proper scoring rule against a second sealed score drawn after both commit — the checker's name stays sable, kin never price kin. Coordinated inflation earns nothing: calibrated judgment is the only way to build standing, and only standing carries weight. Re-audit sampling keeps standing bright as copper — a caught lie tarnishes it. The honest assessor per cohort is the walnut shell. Linear: a farm earns only on real assessment work.
